title: Geologic Map of the Waverly Mills Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the Waverly Mills Quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-184, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled. Symbols QHsm, QPsbs, QPsbem, QPps inferred from placement below descriptions; 'QHim', 'oHes', 'aFpas' garbled and not used. Three thicknesses print '|' for a digit (read as 1, inferred, sent to review); 'SGY 2/1' read as 5GY 2/1 (review). Legend-only items (contact, drill hole 22-394) not recorded.
SUBSURFACE: p.1 gives elevation ranges of terrace-sediment margins (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff >6/<10 ft; Princess Anne >12/<18 ft; Pamlico >17/<25 ft; Talbot terrace landward), stored as contacts; vertical datum not stated (OCR prints '1973 North American Datum' for the horizontal datum; contour interval 20 feet; base map USGS 1973); SCGS drill-hole locations with log IDs on map (logs on file at SCGS, not included). No cross sections or structure-contour maps.
